test_name: flags two overlapping pending requests at one venue, each naming the other and its period (N2-T1)

acceptance_criterion: CR-01: periods are compared as occupied periods (H3)
test_name: widens a pending request by the venue's setup time (N2-T3)

acceptance_criterion: The flag names each conflicting booking reference and its period
test_name: flags a request that clashes, naming each booking and request with its period, and still offers both decisions

acceptance_criterion: The requesting coordinator sees the same flag on their own pending request
test_name: shows it on their own pending request on the event's venue requests

acceptance_criterion: The flag is recalculated whenever a booking for that venue is created, approved, rejected, withdrawn, or released
test_name: names the other's confirmed booking once it is approved, and clears when that booking is released (N2-T8)

acceptance_criterion: The flag is informational: its presence alone neither approves nor rejects any request
test_name: lets a flagged request be approved, and leaves the other Pending, now flagged against the booking
